name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: This is the reward for earning every other trophy first, so there is no separate task to chase. Work through the story, the 100 percent checklist and the side strands, and the platinum unlocks on its own the moment the 54th trophy lands. On Xbox the same 55 show up as achievements, with a 0 Gamerscore Mythic achievement standing in for the platinum.

name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to its end. It is part of the main story, so it cannot be missed, and it unlocks as soon as the mission completes. Use the early missions to get comfortable with driving, shooting and switching between the two leads.

name: Paradise Lost
guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you move on, do the balcony meditation if Lucia offers it, because that is the one missable moment in the whole game. Keep a separate save at the end of the chapter, since there is no mission replay.

name: T**s Ass Drug Money
guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission and the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. The name is shown here exactly as the trophy trackers publish it, in its censored form. Keep a separate save at the end of the chapter, because missions cannot be replayed.
facts: Name shown as published by trackers

name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Complete all of Chapter 3 and the trophy arrives when the chapter closes. By now the map is opening up, so scan vehicles and study animals as you travel, since that progress feeds the 100 percent checklist later. Keep a separate save at the end of the chapter.

name: Top of the World, Ma
guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Take any optional missions that appear along the way, because some side strands only open during the story. Keep a separate save at the end of the chapter.

name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Play the final story mission to the end and this gold trophy unlocks. The story takes roughly 60 to 80 hours, and free roam continues after the credits, so anything left over can be cleaned up afterwards. Keep a save from before the finale in case you want to revisit the ending.

name: Trust
guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a main-story unlock, so just follow the mission markers and play it through. No extra preparation is needed, and it cannot be missed.

name: Break the Bank
guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story unlock, so follow the mission and finish it. Stock up on armour and ammo before a big heist mission, and use cover during the shootouts.

name: Family Matters
guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically as part of the main story, so there is nothing extra to prepare. Play the mission through to its conclusion.

name: DWNFALL
guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. This is a main-story unlock that arrives when the mission ends, so simply play it through. Expect a set-piece mission with plenty of action.

name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is a main-story unlock, so follow the mission markers to the airport and play it through. Keep a save before the mission in case a tough section needs another try.

name: Snow Storm
guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so play it through to the conclusion. Bring full health and armour, and use Combat Focus during the heavy firefights.

name: A Long Road
guide: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work down that checklist. The in-game 100 percent is closer to 60 percent true completion: you need 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of the 18 card sets, every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and every Bret quest. It is the hardest trophy and takes about 100 hours after the story, so chip away at it a category at a time and use the in-game trackers to see what is left.

name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. There are 397 stunt spots in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge passes, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, so you can skip the ones you find hardest. Track your progress on the Touch Pad under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and work through a region at a time. Fast cars help with jumps, planes help with knife flights, and base jumps need height and a clear landing.
facts: 130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try one of each of the nine activity types in the game. You only need to try each once, not win or master it, so sample them as you come across them: races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest. Check the Activities tab on the Touch Pad to see which types you have already tried.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, each with three tiers. The ranges are at Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and at Griffin in Balsero. Practice a challenge until you learn the target pattern, then go for gold: steady aim beats fast firing, and Combat Focus helps on the timed ones. This also counts toward the 100 percent checklist.

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Learn each course with a practice run first, then race for the win: cut corners where the gates allow and keep the drone low and fast. Track locations on the Touch Pad under Activities, then Drones.

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count, so you need 20 distinct events. You can hire cars for races or tune your own at a Mod Shop; a tuned car with good acceleration makes the street races much easier. Mix race types to keep it fresh and check the Activities tab for which ones you have won.
facts: Hire or tune cars at Mod Shops

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2 kilograms, so take a boat out with a fishing rod and fish in the marked area. Watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not let the fish snap the line. A bigger rod and patience help more than rushing.
facts: Fish from a boat with a rod

name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Complete any arcade game. Find an arcade machine, start a game and play it through to the end. Pick the game you find easiest and stick with it; you only need one completion, not a high score.

name: Road to Rehabilitation
description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Finish all of Andy's missions, ending with his final mission. Andy's strand opens as a stranger mission, so take his jobs whenever they appear on the map. Work through them in order and the trophy pops when the last one is done.

name: This Was No Boat Accident
description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Finish all of Kenton's missions. His final mission is called Maritime Disputes, so keep taking Kenton's jobs until that one appears and complete it. Boats and water play a big part in his strand, so get comfortable handling a boat first.

name: The Lone Rider
description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Finish all of Billy's missions. His final mission is called Hometown Heroes, so keep accepting Billy's jobs until it unlocks and play it through. His strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks.

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question marks and letters on the map, so take them whenever they show up rather than leaving them for later. Finish each strand to its final mission; eight completed strands unlocks the silver trophy. This is the focus of roadmap step 3.

name: Supply & Demand
description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Finish all of Randy's missions. His strand revolves around a vehicle wish list, so expect jobs built around finding and delivering specific cars. Keep taking his missions until the final one is done.

name: Spin On This!
description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions, which centre on Kitty Litter Labs. Take his jobs as they appear and work through the strand to its final mission. His strand also counts toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks.

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the game's only missable trophy: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia invites Jason to meditate on the balcony at his house in the morning. Do it before you leave Chapter 1, or the spot is gone for that playthrough. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played, so stay until it finishes. Track your spots under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
facts: MISSABLE: Chapter 1 balcony meditation after Down to Earth
Counts only after the final zen animation

name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests send you after specific rare animals, so follow his clues, track the animal quietly, and take the shot when you have a clean line. Hunting with a scoped rifle and staying downwind makes the approach easier. Bret's quests also count toward 100 percent completion.
facts: Hunt a unique animal for Bret

name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets in Leonida. Cards are found in the world and sold at pawn shops, and cards sold at pawn shops still count toward your sets. Pick the three sets you are closest to finishing and hunt down their missing cards first. You need 15 sets for 100 percent, so this trophy is a good early milestone on the way there.

name: You WAiNKer!
guide: Use the WAiNK phone app to scan 100 locations: hold Up on the phone to scan. The locations break down into 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel so you do not have to backtrack, and track your total under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying, hunting and more, so pick the ones that suit how you already play. You only need 70 of the 80 for 100 percent, so the hardest 10 can be skipped entirely. Check the Challenges list to find the ones closest to done.

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the heat and escape. Get the wanted level up in a quiet area, then break line of sight: duck into alleyways, switch cars, or drive off-road until the stars fade. Make sure your partner is with you when the heat drops, or it will not count.

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route, and keep the wanted level alive the whole time: do not hide long enough for the stars to clear. Move quickly from one shop to the next and keep your partner close.

name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by entering or scanning them. Scan with the WAiNK app as you go, since that also feeds the 100 percent checklist, which needs 200 of the 277 base models. Walk through car parks, traffic and dealerships, and hop into anything you have not logged yet. Track progress under Progress, then Vehicles.

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group of enemies, activate Combat Focus when they are clustered, and drop five before it runs out. A fast-firing weapon and headshots help, and a mission with plenty of enemies gives you the best chance.
facts: Pick a fight with a group

name: Catch Me if You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: At Vice City International Airport, make an unscheduled departure: take a plane and fly out without following a scheduled flight. Get to the runway in a plane, take off, and leave the airport airspace. It is a playful trophy, so do not overthink it: grab a plane and go.

name: Challenging Tank
guide: This one involves the Rhino tank, as the description hints. Get hold of a Rhino tank and use it in combat. Tanks usually appear at high wanted levels or at military areas, so be ready for a heavy police response and bring the tank into a fight once you have it.

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight, and take the valuables without setting off an alarm. If anyone spots you, leave and try again, because any detection voids the attempt.

name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each robbery with a getaway car nearby and a route out of the area, because the police response is heavy. You need five separate successful vault robberies with an escape each time. Grade note: this guide follows PowerPyx, which counts this as Silver; Push Square counts it as Bronze.
facts: Silver per PowerPyx; Bronze per Push Square

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city, so find one, block it or force it to stop, take the cash, and get away before the police close in. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier.

name: The Goodtime State
guide: Visit every region of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail across the whole map, including the smaller towns, the swamps, the keys and the countryside, not just Vice City. The trophy pops once the last region registers, so use the map to spot any area you have never set foot in and go there.
facts: Includes towns, swamps, keys and countryside
Use the map to spot gaps

name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, so find one per gang, hit it, and escape. Learn which areas each gang controls and watch for their operation markers on the map.
facts: Each gang has its own operations

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or vendor along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and drink it while looking out over the water. It is a relaxed trophy: no combat, no timer, just the beach and a drink.

name: Capital Offense
description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a car, in classic style. Drive into a showroom, pick a car, and crash straight out through the glass. It is a nod to the old games, so do it with style and expect a wanted level afterwards.

name: Let's Go Bowling
description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: At Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal all three key valuables, as PowerPyx describes it. Explore the alley, find the three valuables, and take them. Keep an eye out for staff and cameras while you work through the building.

name: Personal Best
guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia, as PowerPyx describes it. Train strength with each character: gym workouts, sports and physical activities all build it up. Switch between the two leads and keep training until both are at maximum strength.
facts: Max strength with Jason and Lucia
Gym workouts and sports build strength

name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: This trophy comes from a story decision. At a choice moment in the story, make your choice and the trophy unlocks. There is no way to force it outside the story, so play through and make the call when it comes. Keep a save before big decisions, since there is no mission replay.
facts: Make the choice when it comes
Keep a save before big decisions

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: Retry something and succeed the second time. The description points at a second attempt that works after a first failure. If something in the game goes wrong the first time, try it again right away and the trophy should pop on the successful retry.

name: The Truth Is Out There
guide: This is one of the cryptic trophies, and its exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites. The app marks it as unconfirmed rather than guessing: keep an eye on the sources listed in this guide for an update. The description suggests an odd, unexpected encounter somewhere in Leonida.

name: Ten Pin
description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: The method for this one is still being confirmed: PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds, and the app says so honestly instead of presenting that as certain. If that reading is right, you would need a bike, a melee weapon and a busy street, and ten knockdowns inside a minute. Check the sources for confirmation before grinding it.
facts: PowerPyx reads it as 10 pedestrians off a bike in 60 seconds

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Launder 250,000 dollars in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other illicit jobs, and your contacts will clean them for a cut. Keep laundering as you play and the total builds up; the trophy pops when 250,000 dollars has been cleaned.

name: Treat Yo Self
guide: Spend 100,000 dollars in total across all shops. Clothes, food, weapons, cars and upgrades all count, so normal spending adds up over a full playthrough. Find shops on the Touch Pad under Style if you need to top the total up at the end. You do not need to spend it all at once.

name: Little Boxes
guide: Buy all 8 garages, 160,000 dollars in total, from the Vice City Real Estate phone app: Mitchel Auto Center 4,000; 7th Avenue 12,000; Vela Rota Drive 24,000; Persistence Road 7,600; Wyatt Motors 21,600; Bonita Court 34,000; Atlantic Court 40,000; Store n' Bolt 16,800. Garages add storage for your cars, and you register cars at a Pay 'N' Spray or a Mod Shop.
facts: Buy via Vice City Real Estate phone app
Register cars at Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shops

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register 10 different vehicles at a Pay 'N' Spray or a Mod Shop. You need free parking spots for them, so buy garages first if you are out of space. Once registered, Scooter Bros can deliver your cars to you for a fee, which makes getting around Leonida much easier.
facts: Register at Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shops
Scooter Bros delivers for a fee
